hq_location.notes: Y Combinator's profile identifies San Francisco as the company's location.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains multiple documentation articles, including quickstart, API, SDK, CLI, and managed-agent documentation.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series A was announced August 6, 2026, within the 18-month window preceding November 9, 2026.

founded_year.notes: Y Combinator lists the company as founded in 2025.

last_funding.notes: TechCrunch reported the $28.5 million Series A on August 6, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog index lists the launch post “Music: your agent writes an original song from a prompt,” dated November 2, 2026, inside the six-month window.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists Standard and Pro plans with monthly prices, as well as a custom plan.

employee_band.notes: Y Combinator's company profile lists 12 team members.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board lists open roles but none is an SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive position.

model_provider.notes: The Managed Agents post names GLM-5.2 as the model used in its benchmark arms. The public material reviewed does not establish a single provider used for all customer agent sessions.

named_customers.notes: I found no verifiable named customers on the company pages or in the press coverage reviewed; published examples describe types of businesses rather than identifying customer organizations.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists roles including technical staff for Agents and RL, growth engineering, and video editing, but none has a title matching the specified AI/ML/data-science role terms.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy page was checked and names no SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS certification.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public docs were reviewed, but they do not identify a specific CRM or sales/marketing system by name. Generic references to a CRM do not identify a product.

product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes the service as infrastructure for agents to autonomously operate businesses and invites users to deploy company templates.
product_one_liner.value: Naïve provides infrastructure and deployable company templates that let teams of AI agents autonomously operate businesses.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: I did not find a sufficiently complete team page or a dated, verifiable announcement/profile establishing a C-level or VP-level join or departure during the period.
